map.计算假肢承重线位置和对线参数，辅助假肢装配和调整: Computes the position of the prosthesis load line and alignment parameters to assist prosthetic fitting and adjustment
Core formulas (from the input variables): weight x 9.8; thighLen x 0.05
map.髋关节中心高度（cm，从坐骨）: Hip joint center height (cm, from ischium)
map.膝关节轴高度（cm，从坐骨）: Knee joint axis height (cm, from ischium)
map.请输入参数计算对线数据: Enter parameters to compute the alignment data
map.承重线是从假肢头部接受腔到假脚的垂直重力线，正确对线应使承重线通过假肢各关键组件: The load line is the vertical gravity line from the socket at the top of the prosthesis down to the prosthetic foot; correct alignment makes it pass through the appropriate positions of the key prosthetic components.
map.矢状面：承重线通过胫骨结节前方，落在假脚的足中部（鞋跟前方约1/3处）: Sagittal plane: the load line passes just in front of the tibial tuberosity and lands at the mid-foot of the prosthetic foot (about one third behind the heel)
map.额状面：承重线通过胫骨中线，落在假脚的足中央: Frontal plane: the load line passes through the midline of the tibia and lands at the center of the prosthetic foot
map.矢状面：承重线通过坐骨支撑面前方，膝关节轴后方，落在假足中部: Sagittal plane: the load line passes in front of the ischial support, behind the knee joint axis, and lands at the mid-foot
map.额状面：承重线通过坐骨结节内侧，膝关节中心，假足中央: Frontal plane: the load line passes medial to the ischial tuberosity, through the knee joint center and the center of the prosthetic foot
map.膝关节稳定性：确保站立期膝关节不打软: Knee stability: make sure the knee does not buckle in stance
map.鞋跟高度变化影响矢状面对线。跟高增加2cm，假脚需前移约1cm或接受腔后倾2-3: Heel height changes affect sagittal alignment. With a 2 cm heel increase the prosthetic foot must move forward about 1 cm or the socket tilt back 2-3 degrees. Different heels need matching SACH heel stiffness.
map.📚 深度解析：假肢对线（承重线）调整: 📝A In-depth analysis: prosthesis alignment (load line) adjustment
map.体重 70kg→负载 686N，残肢长 15cm×宽 12cm：压强=686/(: Weight 70 kg gives a load of 686 N, residual limb length 15 cm x width 12 cm: pressure = 686/(2 x 12 x 15) = 1.91 N/cm2; when the heel is above 2 cm the prosthetic foot shifts back 10 mm.
map.大腿假肢初始内收 7°，膝高-髋高=股长，膝后移量=股长×5%，保证承重线经膝关: An above-knee prosthesis starts at 7 degrees of adduction, knee height minus hip height gives the thigh length, and the knee setback = thigh length x 5%, keeping the load line slightly in front of the knee.
map.跟高≠2cm 时假足前后偏移（>2 后移、<2 前移 10mm），维持承重线稳定: When the heel is not 2 cm the prosthetic foot shifts fore and aft (above 2 it moves back 10 mm, below 2 it moves forward 10 mm), keeping the load line stable and avoiding knee hyperextension or buckling.
map.对线不良最先表现在哪？: Where does poor alignment show up first?
map.三个典型信号：① 接受腔内侧或外侧局部压痛（额状面对线偏内 / 外）；② 站立时: Three typical signs: (1) localized tenderness on the inner or outer wall of the socket (frontal alignment too medial / lateral); (2) the body involuntarily leans to one side when standing or the limb swings out (sagittal alignment too anterior / posterior); (3) step width clearly increases and energy expenditure rises (fear caused by unstable alignment). The adjustment order should be sagittal plane (front-back) first, then frontal plane (medial-lateral), changing only one parameter at a time and walking 20 steps before reassessing.
